sourceFile: 1. BRS-161014 (GMI) Report test new dry machine 2023.11.03_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft has citeable new-dry-machine evidence but the changed-factor and outcome grouping are not reliable.
issues: Changed factor is incoherent and mixes dates, row numbers, methods, temperatures, and conditions.
Baseline/test conditions should be normal dry versus new dry machine/settings, not the current old/new-method list.
Multiple products/processes/dates are merged without preserving subgroup context.
Several outcomes are misclassified or parsed from headers, pictures, or unrelated measurements.
Judgements of improvement are not supported for the full grouped case.
correctionPlan: Rebuild changed factor as new dry machine/process settings versus normal dry.
Keep product, sheet/date, process, temperature, time, and method as subgroup keys.
Separate or clearly subgroup Dec old/new-method VP/FR evidence if it is a distinct validation.
Remove image/header-only and malformed measurement outcomes.
Recalculate only comparable defect, tension, gauss, and function results with row-level citations.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist, but they are too broad and misgrouped for final evidence.
